title: vaccinium vitis-idaea subsp. minus
intro: Vaccinium vitis-idaea subsp. minus, commonly known as dwarf cranberry or Alpine cranberry, is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to the Arctic tundra and subalpine regions of the Northern Hemisphere. This plant is rich in nutrients and offers various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which may help protect against oxidative stress, inflammation, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Vaccinium vitis-idaea subsp. minus include stimulating the immune system, reducing inflammation, and exerting antimicrobial properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, anthocyanins, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
